P2.finish: 50 fresh-moment Adam steps lr .01, score alone

R1.finish: 50 iRprop+ steps, score alone, original moment-derived delta0

R2plus.search: iRprop+, score alone, delta0 .01, bounds [1e-6,.1], factors 1.2/.5

R2minus.search: iRprop-, identical to plus except no backtracking

A0.search: fresh Adam lr .1, score alone; same initial theta as R2; no aids, bend release or culling

common: Existing beam initialization, production score including bend prior and macrocycle seam treatment; angle bends on, n_conformers 16, production output dedup. Shared seed starts across arms, saved start digests. Existing best-seen and closure handling. No optimizer retuning. R2/A0 eager native solver on CUDA, C1/P2/R1 replay search; report timing implementation difference. Existing iRprop stopping masks retained.
machine: Local RTX 2060 SUPER, all six arms paired on same GPU; one GPU job at a time, runkit lock. Profile first two panel parents and reuse complete records. No Colab unless profile warrants it.

measures.energy: Unrelaxed MACE polar-1-s float64 vs correctly labelled reference. Paired top1 (highest score returned), floor (minimum energy returned), mean, percentile 95% parent-clustered bootstrap CI (10000, RNG11), median paired seed-unit difference and parent-mean median, count parents whose mean improves. Save all coordinates and builder symbols with assertion.
measures.distortion: Every returned row: shape constraint statistic (logmeanexp squared direction residuals, tau=2) after proper optimal rotation against own starting candidate ideal; maximum absolute D-M-D angle minus nearest positive-weight Q2 mean, degrees using starting candidate table; geometry label via existing coord_geom.classify; assignment via coord_geom.best_fit_assignment in that geometry and topological_class_keys with starting equivalent-donor groups. Class change means geometry label differs OR graph-level assignment class differs from starting candidate. Graph-level class (reflections equivalent), not stereochemical chirality. Save raw values and labels.
measures.distribution: Pooled row min,p05,p25,p50,p75,p95,max, mean; class-change fraction, obscene fraction (>200 kJ/mol) per arm; also parent/seed fractions and top1 distortion. Report counts and failures.
measures.score_wall: Top1 score paired with C1; solver+assembly wall per parent (seeds batched) summed once per parent, shared prep and MACE excluded; total elapsed separately. Diagnostic overhead separate from solver wall.

failure_policy: Never remove any fixed parent after results. Emit every arm/seed failure; unavailable comparisons explicit, no imputation or replacement. Report finite paired denominators alongside fixed 24. No tuning based on outcomes.
stop: Report table, distortion distributions, spec issues, commit and wait at G-3c0. No G-3c implementation or relaxation.
